issue_request: FHIR-31358 was an Applied FHIR-core DiagnosticReport change request from OO, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R6. It asked for a way to distinguish usage of referenced imaging studies, and the final resolution was to add ImagingStudy as a valid DiagnosticReport.supportingInfo.reference target.
initial_application: Commit 1049a3eebe875f2724cab72cd94ac9352531018b added ImagingStudy to the DiagnosticReport.supportingInfo.reference targetProfile list, and merge commit ebc006438a142400baa260e51ba9f292c36049e5 linked that work to FHIR-31358. No separate explanatory narrative was added by that application commit.
additional_context: DiagnosticReport is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current StructureDefinition still contains both DiagnosticReport.study and the ImagingStudy supportingInfo.reference target. Later Applied DiagnosticReport issues changed the surrounding model: FHIR-45132 broadened supportingInfo.reference targets and FHIR-48389 added DiagnosticReport.comparison plus a supportingInfo comment saying supportingInfo should only be used for resources not referenced elsewhere in the same DiagnosticReport. Those related issues are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The final FHIR-31358 source action is already present, and adding new prose that directs prior/comparison imaging studies to supportingInfo would conflict with the later DiagnosticReport.comparison design.
